note: National outlets' RSS feeds, one or more per country, each checked from GitHub's runners on 2026-09-27 (tools/probe_news.mjs; items in the last 14 days). Each run records whether a feed worked, so the page shows which are live. State media is flagged (state) so its items read as that government's statements. Licence: publishers' copyright; only the headline, a short summary and the link are kept. Entries marked search are a Bing News search for the country's name, used only where no national feed answered; they are aggregator results (nc: terms do not allow commercial reuse) and are read only if robots.txt allows. Focus countries (focus: Thailand, the Philippines, Mongolia, South Korea, Taiwan; plan 2026-09-28) read many outlets, marked by tier (official, national, regional, local-language, specialist) and region, plus topic searches (search, nc) beside their outlets; each keeps per_run items a run and history items in its history. html: an agency's news list on a web page, read from the links matching match. tz: the time zone of an outlet that prints dates without one. max: items read from one feed a run (default 25). clock (e.g. "+08:00") marks a feed that writes local time but labels it UTC; its times are read as local at that offset. relevance "exempt" keeps every item of a specialist outlet whose whole output is security analysis (38 North), even when a headline names no country or relevant word. local marks a feed that mixes in other places' stories: a US TV station-group feed (network-wide stories) or a world-service feed in one language (BBC World Service, RFA), which also covers neighbouring countries and world news. An item is kept only when it names the state or country, or a place in it.
